$comment: What the pre-flight requires to be RESOLVED in the launcher's environment at the moment it launches. Previously preflight-check.sh grepped the launcher's SOURCE for 'export VAR', which is the anti-pattern CLAUDE.md names outright: a string in a file proves nothing about the environment the pipeline gets. It also produced false failures — tier3-metrolinx-run.sh exports ORCH_GATE_MODEL on a shared 'export A B C' line the grep could not see, and sets OUTPUT_DIR/PROJECT_ROOT PER LANE inside run-agent-orchestration.sh, where they belong. A pre-flight that blocks a healthy launcher gets disabled, and then it protects nothing.

required.PRD_FILE: the PRD the run executes; every launcher resolves one before launching

advisory.OUTPUT_DIR: set per lane by run-agent-orchestration.sh for multi-codeline projects; absent in the launcher is normal there
advisory.PROJECT_ROOT: same — per lane for multi-codeline projects
advisory.ORCH_GATE_MODEL: gate model; falls back to llm-settings.json when unset
advisory.ORCH_GATE_PROVIDER: gate provider; falls back to llm-settings.json when unset
